2014_spells.mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no longer than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage. This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can't restore magic to such an object.
2014_spells.mending.effectSummary: Repair one break or tear up to 1 foot wide
2014_spells.mending.fullDescription: Using 1 minute, this spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no longer than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage; This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can't restore magic to such an object. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
